The '''South Anem Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|docking facility]] for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] located on the edge of [[Anem]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nyemari]]. The [[Nyemarian]] mechanic [[Li Preni]] allowed the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and its owner, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to dock there while Solo and his companions undertook a [[Mission to Nyemari|mission]] to the [[Nyemari Royal Palace]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When they returned, Preni lied and told the Rebels he had not told anything to a [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|Glymphid]], but recanted when Solo's companion [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] threatened him. The Rebels then set off to corner the Glymphid, who produced a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] before [[Death/Legends|dying]] from a time-released [[Poison/Legends|poison]].<ref name="Uprising" />

==Description==
The South Anem [[Spaceport/Legends|Spaceport]] was a docking facility for [[Starship/Legends|starships]]; it was located [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[Nyemari]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Anem]], where the city edged onto [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. The facility was little more than a large warehouse, and by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] none of the equipment and fixtures had been repaired in three decades. Only [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and other unsavory types bothered to go there.<ref name="Uprising" />

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the smuggling vessel [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] owned by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] docked at the Spaceport. He had used up a favor owed to him by the [[Nyemarian]] mechanic [[Li Preni]], who had worked there for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Solo and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] were on Nyemari on a [[Mission to Nyemari|mission]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]; they planned on infiltrating the [[Nyemari Royal Palace]] to steal the Duchess' access codes to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Nyemari Imperial Military Installation|Installation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Rebels secured the codes but had to flee through [[Anem]], chased by Royal guards. After losing their pursuers, the Rebels returned to the Spaceport.<ref name="Uprising" />

When the Rebels arrived, they met Preni, who was surprised to see them back. Preni told them he had met a [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] offering a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] to find the Rebels. Preni lied and said he did not know the Rebels; Solo's partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] threatened the Nyemarian with a growl. Preni then recanted and stated he told the Glymphid the Rebels were in town. Thinking the Glymphid was another [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], Solo convinced his companions to find the Glymphid. When the Rebels cornered the alien in an Anem plaza, the [[Unidentified Glymphid messenger|Glymphid]] produced a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] to give to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from [[Rezi Soresh]]. Soresh threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|shipful of hostages]] if Skywalker did not present himself to Soresh. As a demonstration, Soresh had the Glymphid killed using some sort of time-released [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. Skywalker knew he had to go to Soresh's [[Unidentified dead red moon|outpost]], and his companions agreed to join him.<ref name="Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
The South Anem Spaceport appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.<ref name="Uprising" />
